content_metadata.description: The show 'How To Citizen with Baratunde' is a new initiative led by Baratunde Thurston, aiming to empower viewers to become active citizens. It highlights solutions, showcases community actions, and provides practical tools for civic engagement, encouraging collective action to redefine the concept of citizenship.

qAndA.answer: His mother asked him to design a system for how society would function after the collapse of democracy and capitalism.
qAndA.question: What was the assignment that Baratunde's mother gave him when he was 9 years old?

qAndA.answer: He is referring to how the term 'citizen' has been used to exclude certain groups of people based on legal status or other factors, denying them rights and opportunities.
qAndA.question: What does Baratunde mean when he says 'citizen' has been weaponized?

qAndA.answer: He believes that media often focuses on the negative aspects of the world, highlighting problems without showcasing the efforts to address those issues. This creates a sense of powerlessness and isolation for viewers.
qAndA.question: What is Baratunde's opinion on the current media landscape?

qAndA.answer: The show aims to empower viewers to become active citizens by highlighting solutions, showcasing community action, and providing practical tools for civic engagement.
qAndA.question: What is the purpose of Baratunde's new show?

qAndA.answer: They can attend live tapings, interact with the show online, and take action on the issues discussed in each episode.

SUBSCRIBE HERE: http://podcasts.iheartradio.com/HTCWB?sid=YouTube

Emmy-nominated host, writer and producer Baratunde Thurston will launch his new podcast HOW TO CITIZEN WITH BARATUNDE in partnership with iHeart Media. The first episodes will premiere on Thursday, August 27 in the iHeartRadio app, Apple Podcasts, or wherever you listen to podcasts.

How To Citizen with Baratunde reimagines the word “citizen” as a verb and reminds us how to wield our collective power. With humor and empathy, Baratunde explores societal topics that affect us all, speaks with people using their relationships and power for the benefit of the many, and offers audience members ways to participate. With so much media focused on what is wrong with our society, this show focuses on what is right and how to build on it. Our democratic experiment is up for grabs, and we the people will decide, through our action or inaction, where we go next.

Baratunde Thurston is an Emmy-nominated host who has worked for THE ONION, produced for THE DAILY SHOW, advised the Obama White House, and wrote the New York Times bestseller HOW TO BE BLACK. He’s the executive producer and host of WE’RE HAVING A MOMENT, a limited-run podcast series that captures this defining moment of pandemic, policing, and race in the U.S and the creator / host of the weekly pandemic show, LIVE ON LOCKDOWN. In 2019, he delivered what MSNBC’s Brian Williams called “one of the greatest TED talks of all time”. Right now, the writer, activist and comedian is using his powerful voice to help people understand this revolutionary moment with his unique blend of criticism, humor, and optimism.
